pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP7313-33SRG-7 assigns GND (GND) whereas LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns OUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP7313-33SRG-7 assigns OUT (VOUT) whereas LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns IN (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AP7313-33SRG-7 assigns IN (VIN) whereas LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=0.1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Soldering LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB onto a AP7313-33SRG-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 10x (AP7313-33SRG-7: 1 µF p.10 vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 0.1 µF p.11); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7313-33SRG-7 is rated to only 6 V rec. (7 V abs max, p.4) vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB at 30 V rec. (35 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 100 mA (p.5) compared to AP7313-33SRG-7 at 150 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP7313-33SRG-7: 150 mV p.5 vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 900 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP7313-33SRG-7 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (7 V, p.4) than LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (35 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 7 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB requires Vin,min >= 4.8 V (p.5) vs 2 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP7313-33SRG-7: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C) vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP7313-33SRG-7 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP7313-33SRG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) and LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 100 mA (170 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 39.1 °C on AP7313-33SRG-7 (θJA 230 °C/W) vs 45.8 °C on LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (θJA 269.6 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 36.4x ratio (55 µA (p.5) vs 2000 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP7313-33SRG-7 "Reversed SOT23R Pinout Matches AP2210N (1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN), NOT AP7313-SA or LM3480" (p.2) and LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB "Unique SOT-23-3 Pinout (1=OUT, 2=IN, 3=GND) Incompatible With ALL Other SOT-23-3 LDOs in Batch" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose AP7313-33SRG-7 when load current exceeds 100 mA (up to 150 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 55 µA Iq; choose LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB when input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 30 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
